thread.title_full: EU Plans to Increase Deportations Amid Rising Support for Rightwing Parties

author: Paul Serran
title: EU Plans to Increase Deportations Amid Rising Support for Rightwing Parties
text:
• The EU is planning to increase deportations of rejected asylum-seekers.
• Return hubs are to be established in countries outside the EU for deportation purposes.
• The plan is similar to the UK’s previous proposal to send failed asylum seekers to Rwanda and Italy’s plan to send them to Albania.
• Only 20% of individuals with a deportation order are effectively removed from EU territory, according to the European Commission.
• The EU refers to deportation as 'return' to reframe the policy.
• All 27 EU member states will enforce deportation orders issued by other member states.
• Magnus Brunner, the EU’s commissioner for migration, stated that the current 20% removal rate is unacceptable.
• Return hubs will only apply to individuals whose asylum requests have been rejected and will exclude unaccompanied minors.
• Brunner emphasized the need for safeguards to ensure compliance with international law and human rights.
• The existing deal between Italy and Albania for offshore asylum processing has faced legal challenges in Italy.
• The European Commission describes the new proposal as 'tougher but fair' and encourages voluntary self-deportation.
